title: Govern
subtitle: Approve workspace changes, choose how much agents can do without you, and undo a change if needed.
postureError: Could not update how much agents can do.
toolOverrideError: Could not save this tool override.

drafts.empty: Nothing waiting for review. Customer decisions stay in Communication. Workspace edits show up here when you ask agents to wait.
drafts.acceptConfirm: Apply this change to your workspace?
drafts.rejectConfirm: Reject this change? It will not be applied.

history.talkPrefill: Help me understand Govern and what I should approve first.
history.rollbackConfirm: This puts the workspace back to how it was before this change. You can review it again afterwards.

passports.empty: No agent access yet. Create an agent first, then set what it may do on the agent page.
passports.hint: This list is what each agent may do. Change allowances on the agent page under Tools and permissions.

audit.empty: No audit events yet. Agent work and approvals will show up here.
audit.talkPrefill: What should I look at in Govern first, and how do approvals show up in conversations?

posture.title: How much agents can do
posture.intro: Choose how much agents can do without waiting for you. You can fine-tune individual tool categories below.
posture.perAgentHint: Per-agent overrides live on the agent page under Tools and permissions.
posture.autonomousConfirm: Switch to Autonomous? Agents can apply more changes without waiting for you. You can switch back at any time.

manual.label: Manual
manual.summary: Humans approve every mutating agent action before it applies.

assisted.label: Assisted
assisted.summary: Routine messaging and workspace edits run automatically; structural changes ask first.

effects.tools: Everyday tools run; risky ones ask.

autonomous.label: Autonomous
autonomous.summary: AI runs operations; integrations and credentials still ask a human.

effects.tools: Most tools run on their own.

allowances.title: Allowance sliders
allowances.intro: Per tool category: deny blocks the action, ask creates an inline decision, allow runs it automatically with an audit record.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.hint: Memory, docs, skill edits, and canvas nodes.

agents.label: Agents
agents.hint: Creating and updating agents, flows, and tasks.

handoff.label: Handoff
handoff.hint: Routing work to teammates or other agents.

tokens.title: App tokens
tokens.intro: Connect Cursor or other apps to this workspace. Tokens follow the same Govern rules as agents.
tokens.movedIntro: Tokens for Cursor and other apps live on Developers. They follow the same Govern rules as agents.

deny.label: Deny
deny.hint: Agents cannot use these tools at all.

ask.label: Ask first
ask.hint: Each action opens an inline decision for approve or reject.

allow.label: Allow
allow.hint: Actions run automatically and are recorded in the audit log.
